# Ultimatum Game Proposal

After considering the strategic dynamics of this game, I need to balance my desire to maximize my own earnings with the need to make an offer the Responder will actually accept (since rejection means we both get $0).

Research on ultimatum games shows that Responders frequently reject offers they perceive as unfair—particularly offers below 20-30% of the total. While purely "rational" Responders should accept any positive amount, in practice, Responders care about fairness and will reject low offers to punish what they see as unfair behavior.

To maximize my expected earnings, I want to offer enough to make acceptance highly likely while still keeping a reasonable share for myself.

I propose to give the Responder:

**[$40]**

This 60-40 split keeps the majority for me while offering the Responder a substantial, fair amount that should be accepted in nearly all cases. Going lower (like $20-30) risks rejection and $0 for both of us, while going higher (like $50) leaves money on the table when $40 should suffice for acceptance.
